broad: modulation by organism of entry into host via host phagocytosis
modulation by symbiont of entry into host via phagocytosis
narrow: inhibition by symbiont of entry into host cell via phagocytosis

definition: A process in which in a symbiont interferes with or inhibits host phagocytosis by targeting phagocytic signaling or the cellular phagocytic machinery. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host phagocytosis
